Evidence review / source context

Every conclusion starts with a record.

Portal captures, correction notices, receipts, correspondence, and analyst notes enter one evidence register. Records retain their source and date throughout the review.

  • Review status and unanswered questions remain visible
  • Facts stay separate from assumptions and analysis
  • Timeline events remain connected to supporting records

Timeline / traceability

The chronology stays connected on screen and on paper.

Mission Control connects material events to supporting records. The same chronology appears in the final packet.

Findings / human review

Software organizes the record. People approve the judgment.

PermitPulse can assist with classification, chronology, and drafting, but client-facing findings and recommended actions remain a human review decision.

01Evidence is reviewed

02Draft findings are grounded

03A reviewer approves delivery

Human review stays central. The final findings reflect the available record, including gaps and open questions.
